# Zen Mesh — Webhook Operations

> Zen Mesh helps teams receive, validate, observe, and operate webhooks across Stripe, GitHub, and custom sources. Current readiness is DEMO only (local/mock/sandbox and limited cloud-demo scope — not customer-ready or production-live).

Version: 1.0.0 · Last-Updated: 2026-05-29T12:00:00Z · Product scope: webhook ingestion, validation, delivery visibility, and security operations.

Non-claims and proof scope are authoritative — see the Non-Claims and Wedge Evidence links below before inferring production readiness.

- [Website](https://www.zen-mesh.io): Public product site
- [Documentation](https://docs.zen-mesh.io): Docs hub (this site)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/zenmesh/zen-platform): Contracts and internal evidence source of truth

## V1 governance (2026-05-30)

- Not production-live, not customer-ready, not demo-ready as global platform readiness
- Canonical failure-stop: canonical script failure requires STOP — ad hoc runtime is not accepted evidence
- Integrity-chain authority: post-HELPER030 accepted deploy/FLOW/UI/completion evidence requires hash-chain inclusion; comparison is integrity-only — not authentication, not identity proof, not encryption, not replay prevention
- L1 /planes T1: not product-pass; FLOW-03 mandatory; FLOW-01/02/03 accepted proof pending Hermes H220 clean canonical validation
- ST-003 operational SVID rotation MISSING; N086 DeliveryPolicy L2 deferred — not PASS
- [Non-claims registry](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/ai/evidence/v1/non-claims.json)
